messages:
morgan: Hey team :wave: quick heads-up — onboarding checklist links to /runbooks/admin-config which 404s. Scan flagged it. Anyone own that runbook?

devex-bot: Automated link-scan: doc 'onboarding/checklist.md' contains 1 broken link -> /runbooks/admin-config (HTTP 404). Reported at 2026-03-20T10:00Z

alex: @morgan I think that's part of infra runbooks I used to touch. I can take it — can someone confirm the replacement content? Is it now under /kb/v2/admin-ops?

tasha: thanks @alex. There's a newer 'admin-ops' guide in kb/v2 but it doesn't cover the specific 'service account rotation' step. If Alex can add a redirect + short note, that should unblock onboarding.

morgan: SG. if helpful here's a quick sed to fix inline shortlink locally and open PR:

```bash
# replace old path with new shortlink
git checkout -b docs/fix/onboard-admin-link
sed -i 's|/runbooks/admin-config|/kb/v2/admin-ops#service-account-rotation|g' content/onboarding/checklist.md
git add -A && git commit -m "docs: redirect admin runbook link"
# push and open PR
```

alex: I'll open the PR in ~10m and ping for review. cc @leo for QA on the rotation wording.

leo: @alex happy to review. Will skim for technical accuracy and lgtm if fine :+1:

alex: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5243 — small patch + redirect in frontmatter. Requesting quick review from @leo and @tasha

tasha: Looks fine to me, added one nit about phrasing. @alex can you squash and merge when ready? :eyes:

alex: Done and merged. Thanks all :rocket: I also added a short note under /kb/v2/admin-ops about rotation steps (copied from infra runbook).

morgan: Awesome — closing item from onboarding checklist sweep. If anyone sees other broken links ping me. :thumbsup:
